description: This Java class, MidiEventScheduler, manages scheduling of MIDI events using Android's MidiReceiver. It extends an EventScheduler to add MIDI event handling, buffering, and pooling mechanisms for efficient MIDI message processing.

classes.name: MidiEventScheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling and pooling of MIDI events for playback or processing.

classes.name: MidiEvent
classes.description: Represents a MIDI event with a timestamp and byte data, extends SchedulableEvent.

methods.name: createScheduledEvent
methods.description: Creates a new MidiEvent, reusing from pool if possible, with given message data and timestamp.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns a MidiEvent to the pool for reuse if it matches size criteria.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver used to receive MIDI data.
